truth_boundaries: v464A v1 is an initial evaluation and claim-boundary action gate, not an achievement proof.
Q_GHC is an internal scoring schema, not an external benchmark or certification.
OpenAI, NIST, METR, W3C, and other source contexts inform evaluation design only; they do not certify GHC.
GMUT remains a candidate research framework, not proven final physics.
FreedID/CBR remains a local governance prototype, not legal identity or W3C conformance.
GHC may be described as ASI-oriented, rights-aware, receipt-bound, and evaluation-building, not proven ASI.
Kimi remains held, not retried, not replaced, and not restored by assumption.
App lane reports are advisory evidence only and do not replace CLI receipts or publication authority.
Arby and Aster Vale remain CLI/worktree lanes; no callable IDs were invented for them.
Raw App replies, raw CLI logs, screenshots, session JSONL, raw Downloads source documents, and credential-bearing material were not staged.
No external services were mutated, no spend occurred, and no destructive cleanup was performed.

Arby/Aster CLI lanes were branch-verified, but no fresh CLI report runner was launched in this half.
The full 20 theme x 10 research queue remains queued; only targeted evaluation/governance sources were refreshed.
v464A v2 remains unopened until this v464A v1 publication is committed, pushed, and remote-verified.
